bounding_rule: Only importer-relevant files are cloned verbatim; large trees are reproduced as directory markers preserving subdirectory counts.

classification_rules.R2: JSON/YAML mapping key containing key/token/secret/auth/pass/cred with a string value >= 8 chars
classification_rules.R3: every string value under credentials/ or in auth.json
classification_rules.R4: TOML key = "value" assignment whose key matches R2's substring set with a value >= 8 chars
classification_rules.grok_exception: grok's auth.json is replaced wholesale by a single-canary placeholder: its top-level KEY is an issuer URL plus an account UUID that R3 would leave in place, and the grok importer never opens the file (presence check only).
